gripOrHq.title: Executive Wiretaps
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If successful, access two additional cards from HQ.

gripOrHq.title: HQ Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

gripOrHq.title: Private LDL Access
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

gripOrHq.title: Krash
gripOrHq.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

heapOrArchives.title: All-Nighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

scoreArea.title: Bioweapons Engineering
scoreArea.rulesText: Each source of meat damage inflicts +1 meat damage.

scoreArea.title: Netwatch Operations Office
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Trace 2 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Cinderella
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 6 - If trace is successful, end the run, trash a piece of hardware, and do 2 meat damage. This damage cannot be prevented.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Hacker Tracker Central
root.rulesText: After each trace attempt, whether successful or not, put 1 from the bank on Hacker Tracker Central. During a trace attempt, each bit you spend from Hacker Tracker Central increases by 1 both your trace value and your trace limit.

removedFromGame.title: MIT West Tier
removedFromGame.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.
